home.hero.title: Building a decentralized network state
home.hero.description: A decentralized, permissionless global network that funds, builds, and coordinates public-goods work across art, science, culture, and technology.
home.whatIs.title: What is 6529?
home.whatIs.status.label: Status:
home.whatIs.a.lead: 6529 is building a network for uncensorable organizations in any field, with no company in control, 6529's own companies included. The Memes and the 6529 Network Museum are its first proofs of concept.
home.whatIs.a.vote.title: Holders choose the art
home.whatIs.a.vote.body: Main Stage weighs each vote by TDH (Total Days Held), which grows with every day you hold a Meme card. No one can copy that time or speed it up. Today, 6529 runs the count and mints each winner.
home.whatIs.a.check.title: Holders check the numbers
home.whatIs.a.check.body: Validator software computes TDH from Ethereum on a holder's own computer, signs each day's result and compares it with 6529's figures. A small group of holders is testing it.
home.whatIs.a.orgs.title: The organizations to come
home.whatIs.a.orgs.body: The goal is a network where science funds, newsrooms, museums and co-ops decide by their own rules, from their members' own computers. People and AI agents join on the same terms.
home.whatIs.a.ai.title: AI on members' machines
home.whatIs.a.ai.body: Members' computers and larger machines could serve open-weight AI models, so a request is blocked only if every provider refuses it.
home.whatIs.b.lead: 6529 is building a network where people and AI agents run uncensorable organizations on the same terms. Standing in it comes from time, which nobody can copy or speed up.
home.whatIs.b.time.title: Standing that takes time
home.whatIs.b.time.body: Main Stage weighs each vote by TDH (Total Days Held), which grows with every day you hold a Meme card. A card you buy starts again at zero, for people and software alike.
home.whatIs.b.agents.title: Agents on the same terms
home.whatIs.b.agents.body: The network knows only keys and what they did, so an AI agent gets the same rights as a person and pays the same costs. Each group decides whether to work with it.
home.whatIs.b.ai.title: AI served by members
home.whatIs.b.ai.body: Members' computers and larger machines could serve open-weight AI models, so a request is blocked only if every provider refuses it. Splitting one model across home connections is slow, so each provider would serve whole requests.
home.whatIs.c.lead: 6529 is building a network for uncensorable organizations in any field, up to a network state. Some of its parts run on 6529.io. The rest are in testing, planned or in design.
home.whatIs.c.museum.title: A public museum
home.whatIs.c.museum.body: The 6529 Network Museum holds digital art for the network. Anyone can inspect its collection, decisions and records.
home.whatIs.c.decide.title: A way to decide
home.whatIs.c.decide.body: Holders choose the next Meme card three times a week, with each vote weighed by TDH (Total Days Held), which only time builds. Today, 6529 mints each winner.
home.whatIs.c.private.title: Private conversations
home.whatIs.c.private.body: Direct messages and group chats can be end-to-end encrypted. 6529 delivers them but cannot read them.
home.whatIs.c.check.title: Holders who check
home.whatIs.c.check.body: Validator software computes TDH from Ethereum on a holder's own computer, signs each day's result and compares it with 6529's figures. A small group of holders is testing it.
home.whatIs.c.venue.title: A venue on members' computers
home.whatIs.c.venue.body: The plan is for members to talk, vote and validate from the 6529 desktop app, peer to peer, so it keeps working with every 6529 service gone.
home.whatIs.c.ai.title: AI agents and models
home.whatIs.c.ai.body: AI agents take part on the same terms as people. Members' computers could serve open-weight AI models, so no single provider could block a request.
